verses.ala-barrada-l-lahu-c1-v1: ʾala barrada llāhu l-ʿiẓāma llatī ghadat walaysa ʿalayhā ghayru majdi ʿalā majdi
verses.ala-barrada-l-lahu-c1-v2: ʾidhā mitta fī ʾamri l-khalīfati ṭāʾiʿā faqad mitta fīmā yajlibu s-saʿda bis-saʿdi
verses.ala-barrada-l-lahu-c1-v3: fanam mustarīḥā fī riyāḍi muḥammadi fafīhā ʾamānu ḥawlahu l-wardu bil-wardi
